query: How will the 1–2 hour system-ID datasets be designed and validated to cover terrain, payload, reflective surfaces, moving obstacles, glare and sensor failures; what formal loss/optimizer will map simulator parameters to measured sensor statistics?

response.query: How will the 1–2 hour system-ID datasets be designed and validated to cover terrain, payload, reflective surfaces, moving obstacles, glare and sensor failures; what formal loss/optimizer will map simulator parameters to measured sensor statistics?
response.answer: The system-ID datasets will use neural networks with cross-entropy loss and Adam optimizer for parameter mapping. Validation will involve extensive simulations and real-world testing to cover all specified conditions. Sensor failures will be modeled to ensure robustness.
